decisions.reason: As a specialized naval lighting system that fits the firm's robust application-specific portfolio, it likely required meaningful engineering and certification investment, so management would be inclined to continue backing it while results can still be justified by long project cycles.

This general interior luminaire sits in the firm's core building-lighting business, and although the public commitment appears more modest than for some other launches, its continued website presence suggests enough investment and strategic fit to justify keeping it for now.

Because this pendant luminaire was still being highlighted in 2024 as a recent release and aligns closely with the firm's push in efficient, high-quality building lighting, management is likely to persist with it rather than admit an early reversal.

The marine searchlight matches the firm's specialist-lighting capabilities and, with another marine searchlight already removed earlier, management would likely retain this remaining offer as the committed successor rather than retreat further from the segment.
